title: Neutral variations escape selection and remain fluctuating

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Neutral variations escape selection and remain fluctuating

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: Variations that are neither useful nor harmful are not acted on by natural selection and stay variable, which may explain the variability of so-called polymorphic species.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: On the Origin of Species by Means of Natural Selection, or the Preservation of Favoured Races in the Struggle for Life

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: Variations neither useful nor injurious would not be affected by natural selection, and would be left a fluctuating element, as perhaps we see in the species called polymorphic.

fields.label: Agent
fields.value: delphisci Origin of Species claim extractor

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Charles Darwin, On the Origin of Species (1st ed., London: John Murray, 1859), Chapter IV, “Natural Selection”; section “Natural Selection: its power compared with man’s selection, its power on characters of trifling importance, its power at all ages and on both sexes”. Scope: characters of all organisms, especially polymorphic species

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on darwin1859-ch04-02: partially-resolvable, resolvability 0.62

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Neutrality and frequency fluctuation have standard population-genetic tests. Fitness-linked time series remain taxonomically sparse, and drift makes the literal expectation that variation stays fluctuating non-universal.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Classify heritable variants by measured fitness effect and compare temporal frequency variance and persistence of variants indistinguishable from neutral expectations. Support requires neutral variants to lack systematic selection while remaining polymorphic; systematic fitness effects or rapid directional fixation would refute the prediction.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Drift also changes neutral variants and can eliminate polymorphism.

Strict neutrality is difficult to establish rather than merely fail to reject.

fields.value:

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Sequence polymorphism and fitness annotations are public and the site-frequency spectrum is a standard discriminator of neutral and selected alleles. That test covers a modest set of taxa and mostly nucleotide variants rather than the visible polymorphisms Darwin had in mind. Balancing selection is a serious alternative route to long-lived polymorphism, so the analysis is informative for sequence evolution and only a proxy for polymorphic species.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Classify variants by an independent fitness assay or functional annotation, then compare their heterozygosity and time spent polymorphic with neutral expectations. The claim would be confirmed if alleles with no detectable fitness effect persist as a fluctuating component while selected alleles do not, including in species long called polymorphic; it would be refuted if persistent polymorphisms are predominantly maintained by balancing selection.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Nineteenth-century polymorphic species are not a standardized trait class in modern databases.

Balancing selection keeps variation that is useful under some conditions, which the neutral wording does not separate cleanly.

Phenotypic polymorphism data are scattered relative to sequence polymorphism.

data existence: 0.7
